explication: Hooka is a command-line shellcode-loader generator, with a Go library exposing related capabilities. Its principal workflow is to select or obtain a payload, configure encoding and evasion options, and generate an EXE or DLL loader using a chosen execution technique. The README documents the generator’s capabilities; the excerpts show CLI-side generation and library wrappers, but not the complete dispatch path. The graph therefore uses documented relationships for that workflow and avoids inferring unshown internal calls.
